messages:
maya_cs: FYI — Bluecrest onboarding: p95 latency creeping up to ~1.9s (SLO 1.0s). Renewal sync in 32 days. They call out 'snappier UX' as a blocker. Thinking proactive perf plan: compact-route for quick UI queries + heavy model for reasoning paths, plus quantization trial. Thoughts?
diego_se: Can do. Need break down by route type (ui vs batch) and token distro. Any logs on repeated prefixes?
maya_cs: Quick pull: UI routes = 68% of requests, median seq ~180, p95 seq ~540. Long-form summarization routes = 15%, median seq ~1200. KV cache hits low ~8%.
anika_ml: Good signal for model mixing. Proposal: route UI queries to redwood-1b-int4 (fast) and summarize to redwood-7b-q4f16. Also try q4_int8 on 3B for a middle tier. Run A/B on sample eval set of 800 UI prompts to check quality.
trent_pm: Guardrails: start with 15% traffic split to compact model for 72h, monitor p95, user-facing error-rate, and a tiny manual QA from CS. Rollback if convo complaints >2 in 24h.
kevin_am: I'll notify AMs and prepare a short script for CS to capture subjective "snappiness" feedback during the trial.
ops-bot: routing-bot: New rule staged -> bluecrest_hybrid_2026_03, 15% -> redwood-1b-int4, fallback to redwood-3b-q4_int8 then redwood-7b. Metrics: https://dashboard.internal/bluecrest_hybrid_2026_03
diego_se: Routing snippet I'll apply to staging: ```
route: bluecrest_prod
match: customer.bluecrest.ui*
policy:
  - traffic_split: {redwood-1b-int4: 0.15, redwood-7b: 0.85}
  - fallback_chain: [redwood-3b-q4_int8, redwood-7b]
  - cache:
      enabled: true
      prefix_ttl: 300
      min_size: 64
```
anika_ml: We'll run an automated eval on the 800 UI prompts and an additional 200 random long-form prompts. Target: UI quality delta <1.5% (auto metric) and p95 <=0.9s for the compact route.
maya_cs: Action list: diego -> stage rule + bench (today EOD), anika -> run evals (overnight), kevin -> customer survey template, trent -> update renewal playbook with this experiment. Sync 10:00am tomorrow.
trent_pm: If metrics look solid after 72h, propose a phased ramp (15->40->70%) tied to billing impact and CS sentiment.
maya_cs: Thanks team. I'll flag this in renewal tracker and include suggested talking points: expected latency drop, tiny risk to UI phrasing, rollback plan, and how to opt-out.
